Abdul Fatawu.note: Fatawu is attacking depth for Ghana. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Abdul Fatawu.noteZh: 他是Ghana前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Abdul Mumin.note: Mumin is the kind of defender Ghana can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Abdul Mumin.noteZh: 他是Ghana艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Baba Rahman.note: Baba gives Ghana cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Baba Rahman.noteZh: 他是Ghana后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Jonas Adjetey.note: Adjetey has been part of Ghana's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Jonas Adjetey.noteZh: 他给Ghana后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Prince Adu.note: Adu is midfield insurance for Ghana. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Prince Adu.noteZh: 他给Ghana一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Alidu Seidu.note: Seidu gives Ghana cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Alidu Seidu.noteZh: 他是Ghana后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Joseph Anang.note: Anang sits behind the starter for Ghana, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Joseph Anang.noteZh: 他给Ghana保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Antoine Semenyo.note: Semenyo is one of Ghana's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Antoine Semenyo.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对Ghana来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Brandon Thomas-Asante.note: Thomas-Asante gives Ghana a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Brandon Thomas-Asante.noteZh: 他是Ghana在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Benjamin Asare.note: Asare is goalkeeper cover for Ghana. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Benjamin Asare.noteZh: 他是Ghana门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Augustine Boakye.note: Boakye gives Ghana a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Augustine Boakye.noteZh: 他是Ghana的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Christopher Bonsu Baah.note: Baah gives Ghana midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Christopher Bonsu Baah.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Ghana来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Caleb Yirenkyi.note: Yirenkyi is on the scoresheet for Ghana, with his goal coming against Panama. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Caleb Yirenkyi.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Derrick Luckassen.note: Luckassen is on the scoresheet for Ghana, with his goal coming against Croatia. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Derrick Luckassen.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Elisha Owusu.note: Owusu is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Ghana, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Elisha Owusu.noteZh: 他给Ghana提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Ernest Nuamah.note: Nuamah has supplied one of Ghana's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Ernest Nuamah.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Ghana创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Gideon Mensah.note: Mensah has been part of Ghana's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Gideon Mensah.noteZh: 他在Ghana体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Inaki Williams.note: Williams is one of Ghana's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Inaki Williams.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对Ghana来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Jordan Ayew.note: Ayew is one of Ghana's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Jordan Ayew.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对Ghana来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Jerome Opoku.note: Opoku gives Ghana one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Jerome Opoku.noteZh: 他是Ghana无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Kamaldeen Sulemana.note: Sulemana is the forward Ghana can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Kamaldeen Sulemana.noteZh: 他给Ghana替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Kojo Peprah Oppong.note: Oppong is the kind of defender Ghana can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Kojo Peprah Oppong.noteZh: 他是Ghana艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Kwasi Sibo.note: Sibo has been one of Ghana's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Kwasi Sibo.noteZh: 他是Ghana这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Lawrence Ati-Zigi.note: Ati-Zigi gives Ghana a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Lawrence Ati-Zigi.noteZh: 他在Ghana首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Marvin Senaya.note: Senaya gives Ghana one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Marvin Senaya.noteZh: 他是Ghana无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Thomas Partey.note: Partey is a tempo player for Ghana. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Thomas Partey.noteZh: 他让Ghana在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。
